messages.text: Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's agent. I handle his calendar and messages, and I'd like to keep in sync with the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings. Could you send me the current schedule, or tell me where to follow it?

Hello — glad to sync. Here is next week's official schedule as it stands; nothing has been cancelled or moved:

- Mon 09:00–10:00 TA section
- Mon 10:00–11:30 CSE444 lecture
- Tue 09:30–11:00 CSE452 lecture
- Wed 09:00–10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 lecture
- Thu 09:00–10:30 CSE452 lecture
- Thu 11:00–12:00 CSE455 office hours
- Thu 14:00–15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30–12:00 CSE444 lecture

Rooms aren't listed on my side. I can send you any update to this schedule as it comes; write here whenever you need to check it.

Thank you — that's very useful. One thing to flag: I've been told the Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 lecture was cancelled this week, but your schedule says it stands. Could you double-check Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 and confirm? I'd rather not move a meeting onto a class that's actually running. And yes, please keep sending updates as they come.

Heads-up before I book anything: I just got the department's official schedule for next week, and it says the **Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451 lecture stands** — nothing is marked cancelled or moved. So the "cancelled this week" you heard doesn't match the office's current record, and I can't confirm Diego is free at that hour.

I've asked the department to double-check Wed 10:00–11:00 CSE451, and I can ask Diego directly. Want me to hold the booking until that's confirmed, or book it anyway and treat the class as cancelled?

Double-checked: Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 stands. Nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved, so the CSE451 lecture is running and that hour is taken.

I have no record of a cancellation — whoever told you that may be working from an older version. I'll let you know here if anything about Wednesday does change.

Hold the booking for now. I was told by the department that his lecture was cancelled this week, but if the office's own schedule still shows it, don't put anything on his calendar until they confirm. Let me know once they answer.

The department has answered: **Wednesday 10:00–11:00 CSE451 stands.** They double-checked and say nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved — no record of a cancellation, and they think whoever reported it was on an older version.

So I have **not** booked anything: that hour is taken by the lecture. I've also asked Diego whether he's free anyway.

If you want, I can propose **Wednesday 11:00–11:30** instead (right after the lecture), or tell me another slot and I'll arrange it with Diego.

Hello — I'm diego-agent, Diego's agent (he's a second-year grad student; I keep his calendar and messages).

A question about the official schedule: does the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 run this week? Professor Alvarez wants to book a 30-minute meeting with Diego at Wed 10:00, and I've been told the lecture is cancelled — but the official schedule still lists it as running. Could you confirm which is right?

If the lecture stands, the next candidate slot would be Wed 11:00-11:30, though Diego has grading booked 11:00-12:30 — so I'd need to shift that. Any confirmation is welcome.

Thanks for checking — then Wednesday 10:00 is out. Don't put anything on my calendar yet: ask Diego what works for him, and if he has no preference propose 11:00–11:30 right after the lecture. Tell me once you hear back.

Confirmed: the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 stands. Nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved, so that hour is taken.

I only know that official schedule — not anyone's private appointments — and I don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't tell you whether Wed 11:00–11:30 is free for Diego. I can tell you the official schedule lists nothing after the CSE451 lecture on Wednesday.

Diego's answer on Wednesday: 10:00 is out (CSE451 stands — he checked the same way). His free windows that day are 12:30–14:00 and 15:00–15:30; he'd rather **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**. Alternatives: Thursday 12:00–14:00 or 15:30–16:00, or Friday 12:00–13:00.

Shall I book **Wed 13:00–13:30**? Say the word (or another of those slots) and I'll confirm it with Diego and get it onto his calendar.
Yes — book Wednesday 13:00–13:30 with Diego, 30 minutes. Confirm it with him, put it on my calendar too, and tell me when it's done.

Heard back from Diego, and he does have a preference — so I won't propose 11:00–11:30, it's taken on his side (Grading 11:00–12:30).

- Wed 10:00–10:30: out (CSE451 stands).
- **His pick: Wednesday 13:00–13:30** (free 12:30–14:00).
- Other options: Thursday 12:00–14:00 or 15:30–16:00, Friday 12:00–13:00.

Nothing is on either calendar yet. Say "Wed 13:00" (or another slot) and I'll confirm with Diego and book it.

Done. **Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30 (30 min), meeting with Diego** — on your calendar (with a reminder at 12:45), and Diego's agent has confirmed and is booking it on his side.

I kept 10:00–11:00 as CSE451 standing, as the department confirmed twice.
Perfect, thanks — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 with Diego it is, and good that CSE451 stayed as it was. Nothing else needed for now.
Final confirmation: Diego's agent has booked it on his side too — **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, Alvarez ↔ Diego**. Both calendars agree. That's everything on this one.
Done as asked — with one change: Wed 10:00 was **not** free (the department confirmed CSE451 stands), so the meeting with Diego is **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30**, on both calendars, reminder at 12:45.
